title: Path-Independent Deleveraging Rules
abstract: arXiv:2611.26623v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We characterise path-independent auto-deleveraging (ADL) rules as an extended log-exponential family. Immunity to account splitting, merging and reopening further restrict the class. Homogeneity (essentially) restricts the class to a one-parameter family ordered by both fairness and platform risk. Its split-proof members continuously interpolate between proportional division and water-filling. Among these rules, decreasing the parameter reduces risk at the cost of increasing inequality in how accounts are treated. This suggests selecting the parameter through an ex-ante calibration to a risk bound on historical data to choose a maximally fair rule subject to that bound. A counterfactual replay of Hyperliquid's ADL episode on 10 October 2025 finds that a range of intermediate parameters significantly improves on the observed allocation in both burden dispersion and subsequent risk statistics.

translated_title: 路径无关的去杠杆规则
translated_abstract: 我们将路径无关的自动去杠杆（ADL）规则刻画为一个扩展的对数-指数族。对账户拆分、合并和重新开户的免疫性进一步限制了这一类规则的范围。齐次性（本质上）将该类规则限制为一个单参数族，该参数族同时按公平性和平台风险进行排序。其中防拆分的成员在按比例分配和注水法之间连续插值。在这些规则中，减小参数可以降低平台风险，但代价是加剧账户之间待遇的不平等。这表明可以通过对历史数据进行事前风险校准来确定风险界限，在该界限约束下选择最大化公平的规则。对 Hyperliquid 于 2025 年 10 月 10 日发生的 ADL 事件进行反事实重放后发现，一系列中间参数取值在负担分散度和后续风险统计指标方面都显著优于实际观察到的分配结果。
tldr: 该论文将路径无关的自动去杠杆规则刻画为单参数对数-指数族，并通过 Hyperliquid 2025年10月10日 ADL 事件的反事实重放证明，经事前风险校准选择的中间参数规则在公平性与平台风险两方面均显著优于实际观察到的分配方案。
en_tdlr: This paper characterizes path-independent auto-deleveraging (ADL) rules as a one-parameter log-exponential family and shows via a counterfactual replay of Hyperliquid's October 10, 2025 ADL episode that ex-ante risk-calibrated intermediate parameters significantly improve both burden fairness and subsequent platform risk compared to the observed allocation.
